description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mudduwa, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620278
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of land plots, their locations, extent, and registered owners. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property registration and title settlement, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category.
